feature: Support custom AWS endpoints and S3-compatible storage such as Wasabi or MinIO for Terraform/OpenTofu stacks with the optional deployment fields aws_endpoint_url, aws_endpoint_url_s3, aws_endpoint_url_sts, aws_endpoint_url_iam, aws_s3_compatible, aws_skip_sts_check, state_use_lockfile and state_use_path_style (or the matching GitHub variables). The endpoints apply only to the Terraform steps of the action.

Validate the new fields in the schema and with stax validate config: endpoints must be https URLs without credentials, booleans must be true or false, and non-default values are rejected for clouds other than aws.
Add S3-compatible mode and a read-only dry_run input to the setup-state workflow for cloud: aws.
bugfixes: Disable state locking for plans when no-lock is true. The plan step passed a bare -lock (meaning -lock=true), so dry-run plans still acquired the state lock.
Skip Infracost setup, breakdown and report uploads when INFRACOST_API_KEY is unset, so plans no longer log a fake Error: INFRACOST_API_KEY is not set.
docs: Document S3-compatible backends (Wasabi, MinIO), the OIDC limitation and the lockfile caveat.
